Container.Name: ps5-patch-downloader
Container.Overview: Search PlayStation 5 game updates and download them straight from the official Sony CDN, with a WebUI, a persistent download queue (pause, resume, retry), hash verification and a firmware filter. Game update packages only - this container never downloads or installs PlayStation system software.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings and the editable PROSPERO rules file.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where the finished .pkg files are written.

Config.Name: Parallel downloads
Config.Description: How many packages download at the same time.

Config.Name: Bandwidth limit (Mbit/s)
Config.Description: Total download limit across all jobs. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: Maximum firmware
Config.Description: Updates that need a newer firmware are marked incompatible, e.g. 12.60. Empty = no filter.

Config.Name: Metadata cache TTL (hours)
Config.Description: How long index lookups are cached before they are fetched again.

Config.Name: Parallel pieces per package
Config.Description: Parallel connections within one split package. 2-4 is usually plenty.

Config.Name: WebUI user
Config.Description: Optional HTTP basic auth user. Leave empty to disable authentication.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for other tools (X-API-Token header).
